summary: Tennis tournament 2025 Austin Challenger Date 3–9 November 2025 Edition 1st Category WTA 125 Prize money $115,000 Surface Hard Location Austin , United States Champions Singles Renata Zarazúa Doubles Maria Kozyreva / Iryna Shymanovich Austin Challenger · 2026 → The 2025 Austin 125 was a professional women's tennis tournament played on outdoor hardcourts . It was the first edition of the tournament and part of the 2025 WTA 125 tournaments . It took place at the Austin Tennis Academy in Austin , United States between 3 and 9 November 2025.
